name: 칼라
motion_summary: Eternal Return Karla Shackles: red-haired pirate captain, burgundy tricorn hat with skull emblem, pale face, confident amber eyes, black-red pirate outfit and harpoon crossbow. R launches an enormous anchoring harpoon into the ground, chains spread and tighten then pull inward. Frames: ready; grip harpoon weapon with two hands; raise muzzle; heavy launch recoil; giant harpoon lands low right (inside cell); chains extend from anchor in a small radial pattern; Karla braces and leans back; both hands tug; chains contract sharply around central anchor with bright steel-orange impact; loose chains settle; weapon lowered; ready. No ships, ocean, scenery or actual enemies. Steel chains, orange-gold binding sparks, distinctive pirate face stays unobscured.
visual_review: 삼각모자·붉은 머리·작살 화기가 유지됩니다. 들어올림/발사/버티기/당기기 동작과 사슬 수축이 구분됩니다.
